notes.title: [UPDATE] A New Era for Darksword
notes.notes:
Champions,

Thank you for the incredible love and support you’ve shown for Darksword: Battle Eternity. It’s hard to believe it’s already been over a year since our global launch!

As we approach the holiday season, we’re excited to roll out updates that address longstanding feedback and make the game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

Improved Item Drop RatesStarting now, item drop rates and variety in the single-player story mode will be significantly increased. This change is designed to reduce unnecessary grinding and create a more engaging experience for a wider audience.

Enhanced Multiplayer Co-opWe’ve made notable changes to the multiplayer co-op mode, including a significant reduction in difficulty to make it more accessible. Additionally, we’ve lowered the latency threshold for random matchmaking, ensuring matches happen more frequently and smoothly.

New Leaderboard Season & Battle Pass UpdatesA fresh leaderboard season is on the horizon, giving new players a chance to rise through the ranks. We’re also revamping the free and premium battle pass rewards to feature some of the rarest and most sought-after weapons in the game.

We deeply appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we continue to improve Darksword: Battle Eternity. Thank you for being an integral part of this incredible journey.

See you in the Twisted Corridors!

– The Darksword Dev Team

notes.title: [Update] Single DLC & Improved Gameplay
notes.notes:
Champions!

The endless battle in the Twisted Corridors has just become more intense!

Today, we are presenting our first single-player premium DLC package: Nephilim. In this dungeon (sorry, no elevators this time), you will encounter familiar foes and new bosses alike, more lucrative loots to exploit, and a chance to craft new legendary weapons! But be careful. The fight will be challenging even for the best and the most fearsome among all. The DLC package will include the following:

 Three new boss-level enemies: Glutton, Netherhound, and Blood Luna
 Three new legendary weapons: The Redeemer (sword), King's Greed (sword), and Immortal Soul (bow)
 Materials for the new legendary weapons: Nephilim Shard, Apocalypse Metal, Golden Greed, Chaos Crystal, Crimson Core, and Bone Shard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768264/08622371038f1c0fc3aa6e5248dceaa766ffd616.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768264/4dc76d779f83b7705c5bb0cf1d62a31e708a934f.png
But hey, that's just paid content! Here are the baseline changes and improvements:

 Increased player character level cap from 60 to 75
 Introducing new power-up skill: the Battle Axe
 Increased movement speed (yes, faster than before)
 Increased Gold and XP reward amount for single player story mode
 Increased chance to drop Rare Crystal and Heroic Crystal from semi-bosses in Infernum and Archeaon
 Improved shield parry success rate (just thrust your shield when they attack after the blink!)
 Increased weapon upgrade RNG success rate (should be seeing much less fails)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768264/8c657ab8f4dea5b396dcf6fbc8e5b52f106a5511.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768264/3f2bdd740bf5a720ddae5a4f01d44fce52234468.png
Phew, what else. Ah yes, the game is now built with Unreal Engine 5! This was a tough nut to crack, but here it is. We also renewed the menu in the lobby areas to increase user visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768264/5ec6768c8a0fc9d41f9c1f936a155a52fa080ba2.png
Before we move on, I just want to say thank you to those who have been showing continued support for this game, and also to the wave of newcomers joining our Discord community. This really means a lot to us. Your feedback, whether positive or negative, is the most valuable source of inspiration. The game has been out for a while. But we believe we have a good package for everyone to enjoy. As such, we will continue to find ways to make the game better and enjoyable going forward! Thank you!

Darksword Dev Team

notes.title: [Update] Darksword: Season 2 Begins!
notes.notes:
Champions!
Season 2 of Darksword: Battle Eternity is here!
With the new season, leaderboards for both Story and Co-Op modes will be reset along with new Battle Passes. Please note that character progression, items and materials will not be impacted by the season renewal. You can also check out the top player lists of the previous season at our Discord channel! (https://discord.gg/9qMkwaPFhh)


Here are the list of changes we made for this update:

- Season 2 Leaderboards: Players will be able to compete on both single-player story mode and multiplayer co-op mode progresses. However, character level, gear, items, collected figures, achievement progression, and gold will remain the same for continuous players.
- Season 2 Battle Passes: Players will be able to earn Season Points (SP) for the renewed Battle Passes. For the Premium Pass, the final reward will be a new Legendary tier weapon "Wrath of Barbatos"
- Removed Holiday season ornaments along with a few bug fixes.
- Waiting time for the "Quick Match" mode for co-op has now been reduced to 20 seconds. This will allow players to start a solo session of the co-op maps faster.

While this build is mainly focused on the new season, we are also working on additional features in the next!

Thank you, and see you in the Twisted Corridors!

Darksword Dev Team
